places.title: Area code 808
places.snippet: The number that dials the islands. NANP code for all Hawaiian Islands (and Wake). Assigned August 8, 1957 — 8/8 — two years before statehood; never split, never overlaid. Ten-digit dialing since Oct 24, 2021 (988 lifeline conflict). Identity mark, not a vacation code.

places.title: Angel number 808
places.snippet: Abundance, manifestation, infinite cycles — how people read the digits in numerology circles. Belief talk, not weather FACT. No money promises; no scraped blog essays.

places.title: Eight in Scripture
places.snippet: Anchors people cite: circumcision on the eighth day (Gen 17:12); eight souls through the flood (1 Pet 3:20); resurrection morning read as the eighth day / new creation. Keep text separate from interpretation. Not a church, not a sermon mill.

places.title: Lucky 8 / 发
places.snippet: In Chinese folk numerology, 八 (bā) sounds like 发 (fā) — prosper. Eights show up on phones, plates, wedding dates. 吉利 talk and language notes — not investment advice.

places.title: The 808 (TR-808)
places.snippet: Roland TR-808 Rhythm Composer (1980). Commercial flop, then the kick behind electro, hip-hop, house, trap. Machines, kicks, producers — not a merch drop.

places.title: ∞ Infinity lounge
places.snippet: Digit 8 rotated = infinity. Cycles, loops, “what never ends” — bridge seat for angel-number, music, and math nerds without owning any one creed.

seed.name: Hurricane Nolo products
seed.text: FACT: NWS Honolulu lists Hurricane Nolo products: Tropical Storm Warning + Hurricane Watch for Big Island zones, Tropical Storm Watch for Maui County zones. Official hubs: https://www.weather.gov/hfo/ https://www.hurricanes.gov/ Which product is up for your zone?

seed.name: High Surf Advisory
seed.text: FACT: High Surf Advisory remains for east-facing Molokai and Maui and east/southeast Big Island shores through Sat 6 PM HST. https://www.weather.gov/hfo/ East shore plans: stay out or watch from higher ground?

seed.name: Weekend look
seed.text: FACT: Honolulu grid: Saturday scattered showers (~40%), high near 86, ENE ~20 mph; Sunday isolated showers then partly sunny, high near 86. https://www.weather.gov/hfo/ Wetter pocket on your side?
